items.text: Eavesdropping is rude. I am conducting field research.

sections.label: The picture
sections.text: Dreamy: a woman at a cafe table, notebook open, eyes sliding sideways.

items.text: Me: minding my own business. Also me: deeply invested in whether the guy at table 4 gets a second date.

sections.label: The picture
sections.text: Dreamy: someone leaning so far out of their chair they're almost out of frame.

items.text: When the couple arguing lowers their voices: respectfully increasing my focus.

sections.label: The picture
sections.text: Dreamy: a book slowly lowering to reveal two wide eyes.

items.text: Date update from table 4: he just said 'as an entrepreneur.' This date is over and only I know it.

sections.label: The picture
sections.text: Dreamy: the watcher wincing behind a coffee cup; the oblivious couple beyond.

items.text: The barista and I exchanging a glance because we both heard that.

sections.label: The picture
sections.text: Dreamy: two heads turned toward each other across a counter, one raised eyebrow each.

items.text: I don't have a favorite show. I have a bench.

sections.label: The picture
sections.text: Dreamy: an empty park bench drawn like a movie poster, spotlight and all.

items.text: When someone's phone call finally gets good and they walk away: devastating loss of signal.

sections.label: The picture
sections.text: Dreamy: a figure walking off, speech bubble trailing away; the watcher reaching after it.

items.text: 'What do you do for fun?' Me, thinking of the man who argued with a pigeon for 20 minutes: 'I guess I'm into nature.'

sections.label: The picture
sections.text: Dreamy: a man mid-argument with an unbothered pigeon.

items.text: Caught staring. Options: look at phone. Squint like I'm reading the menu behind them. Wave. (Never wave.)

sections.label: The picture
sections.text: Dreamy: three small panels of escalating bad choices, the third crossed out.

items.text: Them: 'Sorry — were you listening?' Me, holding a notebook and pen: 'No.'

sections.label: The picture
sections.text: Dreamy: the watcher mid-scribble, frozen, pen still on the page.

items.text: Flight delayed 3 hours. Everyone else: devastated. Me: three bonus hours at the observation deck.

sections.label: The picture
sections.text: Dreamy: rows of slumped travelers, one person sitting up straight, thrilled.

items.text: When two of my favorite regulars interact for the first time: crossover episode.

sections.label: The picture
sections.text: Dreamy: two strangers shaking hands, drawn with fireworks like it's historic.

items.text: Someone rehearsing a conversation alone in their car — pausing my podcast out of respect.

sections.label: The picture
sections.text: Dreamy: a parked car, gesturing silhouette inside; the watcher removing one earbud.

items.text: I've assigned a full backstory to a man I've seen twice. His name is Gerald. His name is almost certainly not Gerald.

sections.label: The picture
sections.text: Dreamy: an ordinary man haloed by an elaborate hand-drawn diagram of his invented life.

items.text: My toxic trait: deciding two strangers should be together and taking it personally when they leave separately.

sections.label: The picture
sections.text: Dreamy: two figures exiting opposite sides of the frame; the watcher heartbroken between them.

items.text: The couple I watched on their first date just walked in with a stroller. I have seen this show from the pilot.

sections.label: The picture
sections.text: Dreamy: same cafe table drawn twice — first date above, stroller below.

items.text: When they finally say the name of the person they've been complaining about for an hour: season finale.

sections.label: The picture
sections.text: Dreamy: the watcher gripping the table, coffee sloshing.

items.text: 'Touch grass.' I'm literally at the park. Watching. Everyone.

sections.label: The picture
sections.text: Dreamy: a serene figure on a blanket, surrounded by tiny sketched vignettes of everyone else's business.
